POLICY_TREND_LOW_TURNOVER.policy_name: Low-Turnover Moving Average Trend Filter with Hysteresis

H1.hypothesis_statement: Low-turnover controls reduce simulated transaction costs relative to uncontrolled simple trend.
H1.notes: H1 confirms that hysteresis bands and holding periods reliably eliminate whipsaw transaction fees.

H2.hypothesis_statement: Reduced transaction costs improve net portfolio outcomes relative to otherwise equivalent policies.
H2.notes: Evaluates whether lower fee drag translates directly into superior net equity growth.

H3.hypothesis_statement: Low-turnover policies reduce maximum drawdown compared with their uncontrolled versions.
H3.effect_size_summary: Max drawdown changed from -65.12% to -39.20% (drawdown severity reduced by 25.92%).
H3.notes: Assesses whether hysteresis filters prevent adverse whipsaws at cyclical turning points.

H4.hypothesis_statement: Low-turnover timing policies outperform BTC buy-and-hold after transaction costs.
H4.effect_size_summary: Low-turnover policy return (-28.80%) vs Buy & Hold (-9.69%), excess: -19.10%.
H4.notes: Critical empirical test of active timing value proposition against passive holding.

H5.hypothesis_statement: Derived regime features add incremental value beyond price-only trend indicators.
H5.effect_size_summary: Derived regime net return (-42.33%) vs Simple Trend (-62.60%), excess: +20.27%, Sharpe diff: +0.73.
H5.notes: Evaluated using DERIVED research classifier. Canonical CBE-0.7.0 parity remains not established (NOT_EVALUABLE_CANONICAL_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE).
